id.description: Fake {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert#id}, to be able to plot the alerts on the chart.

name.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#alertOutputs} that generated the alert.

primaryModelOutput.description: A `number` representing the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#algorithmOutputs} for the alert.

featureContributions.description:
Map of {@link Feature#id} to its normalized contribution value for the alert.
It contains the following fields:
- `featureName`: The {@link Feature#id} of the feature.
- `contribution`: Normalized (`0-1`) value of the feature contribution for the alert.
- `sensorId`: If found, it will contain the related {@link Sensor#id}.
- `actualValue`: The numerical value of the feature at the time of the alert.

title: Represents the data structure for an alert in the Experimental Model Preview Page.
name: ReliabilityMlModelExperiment.AlertData
